answer: Farming becomes a grove bet on surviving 118 epochs of grading, and every cipher settlement recomputes the voyage schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 118 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 8 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
